Mutations in COL4A1 disrupt the synthesis and assembly of type IV collagen, a critical component of basement membranes. This disruption leads to impaired vascular integrity, manifesting as retinal arterial tortuosity in the eye and small vessel disease in the brain, which can also include ocular anomalies.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in COL4A1 that are exclusively associated with one disease phenotype and not the other, or evidence that the functional consequence of COL4A1 variants differs between the two conditions (e.g., gain-of-function for one and loss-of-function for the other). _(variant: gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/13-37876463-C-T)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared genetic basis in COL4A1 highlights potential therapeutic strategies targeting basement membrane integrity or vascular health that could benefit patients with either retinal arterial tortuosity or brain small vessel disease.
